remarks: Rare opportunity to live on one of Westport's most desirable Compo Beach cul-de-sacs. Beautifully restored and reimagined for today's lifestyle, this character filled 1925 Colonial features beamed ceilings, exposed stone, four fireplaces and more. Grand entertaining spaces include an expansive Dining Rm/Living Rm with 10' ceilings and two FPLS, a bright modern Kitchen and Family Rm w/FPL, a relaxing Sunroom and an inspired glass-enclosed Office for working from home. Five Bedrooms on the second floor include Primary Suite and second BR, each with vaulted ceiling, three add'l spacious BRs, a laundry rm plus a Second Office/Study Rm. Fin LL has Playroom/Gym. Set on over half an acre with old stone walls, mature trees and gardens, the home's outdoor amenities include an 18'x 38' Gunite Pool with Spa and Safety Cover, an award-winning Pool House with bath, changing rm and outdoor shower, patio w/pergola and built-in BBQ, a wood-burning fire pit and a fenced vegetable/cutting garden. Walking distance on sidewalks to the beach, train and restaurants at Saugatuck, Compo Pkwy is a quiet cul-de-sac just across the street from Westport's Longshore Club, with 18-hole golf course, tennis, pickle, sailing school and ice skating rink in the Winter months. At the beach, yet with privacy and property, this home offers the best of both worlds -beach and country living- in a premium Westport location.
